name: Understand the two kinds of work

pages.text: Create uses rotational power for its machinery. GregTech’s early industry uses steam, followed by EU-powered machines.$(br2)Build each system around its own connections and requirements. The workshops support one another through materials and components, and JEI shows where a project needs something from the other workshop.
Your first GregTech boiler follows its crafting recipe, including a Blast Furnace. Use that recipe as your checklist while building the Create equipment that supports your other projects.
